0022600007.text: This is Denver's first game of the 2026-27 season, as the Nuggets visit the Oklahoma City Thunder, who have not played yet this season and have one game to play before this one. Spencer Jones is listed as a game-time decision with a hamstring injury. In the 2025-26 season series, Denver lost 1-3, but the Nuggets won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 25% chance to win.

0022600110.text: Neither the Nuggets nor the Pelicans has played a 2026-27 game yet, and Denver hosts New Orleans in this regular-season matchup. Denver won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 122-116 road win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver an 80% chance to win.

0022600127.text: Neither the Nuggets nor the Golden State Warriors has played a 2026-27 game yet, and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody, who are both out after knee surgery. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Denver won the most recent meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 70% chance to win.
